#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

// Fast input reader
struct InputReader {
    static const int BUF_SIZE = 1024;
    int pos, size;
    char buf[BUF_SIZE];
    FILE* stream;

    InputReader(FILE* s) : stream(s), pos(0), size(0) {}

    int read() {
        if (size == -1) return -1;
        if (pos >= size) {
            pos = 0;
            size = (int)fread(buf, 1, BUF_SIZE, stream);
            if (size <= 0) return -1;
        }
        return buf[pos++] & 255;
    }

    bool isWhitespace(int c) {
        return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1;
    }

    int nextInt() {
        int c = read();
        while (isWhitespace(c)) c = read();
        int sign = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sign = -1;
            c = read();
        }
        int res = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw runtime_error("InputMismatch");
            res = res * 10 + c - '0';
            c = read();
        } while (!isWhitespace(c));
        return res * sign;
    }
};

// FFT functions (translated from Java)
void fft(vector<double>& a, vector<double>& b, bool inverse) {
    int n = (int)a.size();
    // bit reversal
    int shift = 32 - __builtin_ctz(n);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int j = __builtin_bswap32(i << shift);
        // Actually we need to swap bits; in Java they used Integer.reverse(i<<shift)
        // Let's implement a simple reversal: we can precompute or use standard method.
        // Simpler: use a function to reverse bits of i for given log2(n)
        // Since n is power of two, we can compute j by iterating bits.
        // Let's do: int j = 0; for (int t=i, s=1; s<n; s<<=1, t>>=1) j = (j<<1)|(t&1);
        int j = 0;
        int t = i;
        for (int s = 1; s < n; s <<= 1) {
            j = (j << 1) | (t & 1);
            t >>= 1;
        }
        if (i < j) {
            swap(a[i], a[j]);
            swap(b[i], b[j]);
        }
    }
    for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
        int halfLen = len >> 1;
        vector<double> cs(halfLen), sn(halfLen);
        for (int i = 0; i < halfLen; i++) {
            double angle = 2 * M_PI * i / len * (inverse ? -1 : 1);
            cs[i] = cos(angle);
            sn[i] = sin(angle);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
            for (int j = 0; j < halfLen; j++) {
                double wA = cs[j];
                double wB = sn[j];
                double uA = a[i + j];
                double uB = b[i + j];
                double vA = a[i + j + halfLen] * wA - b[i + j + halfLen] * wB;
                double vB = a[i + j + halfLen] * wB + b[i + j + halfLen] * wA;
                a[i + j] = uA + vA;
                b[i + j] = uB + vB;
                a[i + j + halfLen] = uA - vA;
                b[i + j + halfLen] = uB - vB;
            }
        }
    }
    if (inverse) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] /= n;
            b[i] /= n;
        }
    }
}

vector<int> multiplyMod(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b, int mod) {
    int need = (int)a.size() + (int)b.size() - 1;
    int n = 1;
    while (n < need) n <<= 1;
    if (n < 2) n = 2;

    vector<double> aReal(n, 0.0), aImag(n, 0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); i++) {
        int x = (a[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        aReal[i] = (double)(x & ((1 << 15) - 1));
        aImag[i] = (double)(x >> 15);
    }
    fft(aReal, aImag, false);

    vector<double> bReal(n, 0.0), bImag(n, 0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)b.size(); i++) {
        int x = (b[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        bReal[i] = (double)(x & ((1 << 15) - 1));
        bImag[i] = (double)(x >> 15);
    }
    fft(bReal, bImag, false);

    vector<double> faReal(n), faImag(n), fbReal(n), fbImag(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int j = (n - i) & (n - 1);

        double a1r = (aReal[i] + aReal[j]) / 2;
        double a1i = (aImaginary[i] - aImaginary[j]) / 2;
        double a2r = (aImaginary[i] + aImaginary[j]) / 2;
        double a2i = (aReal[j] - aReal[i]) / 2;

        double b1r = (bReal[i] + bReal[j]) / 2;
        double b1i = (bImaginary[i] - bImaginary[j]) / 2;
        double b2r = (bImaginary[i] + bImaginary[j]) / 2;
        double b2i = (bReal[j] - bReal[i]) / 2;

        faReal[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
        faImag[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;

        fbReal[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i;
        fbImag[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r;
    }

    fft(faReal, faImag, true);
    fft(fbReal, fbImag, true);

    vector<int> res(need);
    for (int i = 0; i < need; i++) {
        long long aa = (long long)(faReal[i] + 0.5);
        long long bb = (long long)(fbReal[i] + 0.5);
        long long cc = (long long)(faImag[i] + 0.5);
        long long tmp = aa + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30);
        res[i] = (int)(tmp % mod);
        if (res[i] < 0) res[i] += mod;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr); cout.tie(nullptr);
    InputReader in(stdin);
    int mod = 998244353;
    int n = in.nextInt();
    int k = in.nextInt();
    vector<int> v(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
        int x = in.nextInt();
        v[x] = 1;
    }
    vector<int> ans = {1};
    int p = n / 2;
    while (true) {
        if (p % 2 != 0) {
            ans = multiplyMod(ans, v, mod);
        }
        p /= 2;
        v = multiplyMod(v, v, mod);
        if (p == 0) break;
    }
    long long res = 0;
    for (int x : ans) {
        res = (res + (long long)x * x) % mod;
    }
    cout << (int)res << endl;
    return 0;
}
